intro.text: A noble house of the Final Empire, headed by Lord Teven Renoux, a western lord with power in the Farmost Dominance.

description.text: House Renoux aims, within ten years, to have the wealth and contacts to raise a keep in Luthadel, which would make it a Great House.
In Mansion Renoux, a room furnished and draped in maroon lies to the right of the entryway.

items.text: The real Teven Renoux was killed and replaced by OreSeur, an impostor working with Kelsier. Playing Lord Renoux under Kelsier's direction, he moved to Fellise, supposedly to expand a trade in Southern weapons; in truth the trade armed the skaa rebellion.

Kelsier and his crew work out of Lord Renoux's estate at Fellise, an hour outside Luthadel. Renoux has Vin pose as the daughter of a favoured cousin, whom he presents to the noble houses to raise his family's standing.
At her first ball, Vin realises the nobles are looking at Valette Renoux, the part she plays, rather than at her.
